title: The Lampbearer / Last Flame
premise: The lighthouse goes dark; a girl carries the last flame through a night forest and up the storm cliffs.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Original real 3D diorama with procedural pixel textures, lit/shadow-casting original pixel sprite, practical lights, fog, rain and tilt-shift/bloom post. No upstream demo geometry or textures. Three.js MIT: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js .
